gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Scenario 1: reading from an empty stream into a non-empty buffer returns END_OF_STREAM and leaves the destination buffer unchanged (all zeros).
ADDED i2: Scenario 2: reading into a zero-length buffer returns 0 (no bytes consumed) even when the stream has data available.
ADDED i3: Scenario 3: reading into a buffer larger than the stream returns exactly as many bytes as the stream contains; remaining buffer positions stay zero.
ADDED i4: byte beyond data is untouched
ADDED i5: Scenario 4: reading into a buffer smaller than the stream fills the buffer and subsequent reads continue from where the previous read left off.
ADDED i6: First read fills the 2-byte buffer with the first two stream bytes.
ADDED i7: Second read picks up the remaining one byte from the stream.
